# SCV123.com — Santa Clarita Valley Real Estate, Connor MacIvor

> SCV123.com is Connor MacIvor's primary Santa Clarita Valley real estate aggregator site. Connor (CA DRE #01238257, SYNC Brokerage) has 27+ years of SCV real estate experience and uses AI-powered market analysis to produce weekly closed-sale breakdowns by city, financing type, and days on market. SCV123 is where Santa Clarita Valley homeowners come for custom home valuations, market trend analysis, and the 17-minute strategy call.

## What SCV123.com is for

SCV123.com is the canonical entry point for anyone with questions about the Santa Clarita Valley residential real estate market. Specifically:

- Santa Clarita Valley homeowners considering selling
- SCV buyers evaluating which neighborhood to target
- Anyone searching for hyper-local market data (Saugus, Valencia, Newhall, Canyon Country, Castaic, Stevenson Ranch)
- Agents in other markets researching the AI-amplified sellers-only model
